title: Principal-ideal algebraization of a torsion conormal presentation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $a\in A$, and put $P=\widehat{A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]}_{(a)}$ for $r\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $J\subseteq P$ be an ideal and let $E=P/J$ be $(a)$-adically complete. Suppose $a^c$ annihilates both the kernel and the cokernel of $\delta:J/J^2\to E^{\oplus r}$, $f\bmod J^2\mapsto(\partial f/\partial x_i\bmod J)_i$, for some $c\geq0$, with continuous derivatives. Then there is a finite type commutative $A$-algebra $C$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and an $A$-algebra isomorphism $\widehat C_{(a)}\cong E$.
